concerns.text: FR-005 mandates the sign-preserving mean correlation as the connectivity-strength metric and primary outcome. Tasks.md's 'Metric note' and T004 demote it to a 'descriptive secondary' and make mean absolute correlation primary. Constitution VII does mandate absolute correlation, but the spec FR-005 has not been amended — the task list silently rewrites a MUST-level FR. Amend spec FR-005 (or record the constitution-overrides-spec reconciliation explicitly in the spec) before tasks finalize the primary metric.

T007 computes per-window paired t-tests with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR across all windows (dynamic_fdr.csv, tagged SC-008). The plan explicitly states 'no multiple-comparison correction across windows; series are reported descriptively' and SC-008 in the plan says no formal correction. T007 directly contradicts the plan's statistical procedure and cites an SC-008 that does not exist in spec.md. Either update the plan/spec to authorize window-wise FDR or drop the FDR step.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 Step 2 and coverage table row 'FR-003, FR-019'
concerns.text: T003 Step 2 and the coverage table reference FR-019 (confound regression with motion params, CompCor, global signal), but no FR-019 exists in spec.md. Tagging a task with a nonexistent requirement breaks traceability; the confound-regression deliverable is unrequested scope relative to the spec (which mandates raw time-series for connectivity). Add FR-019 to the spec or remove the tag/scope.

T004 writes 4×4 matrices with six edges validated against connectivity.schema.yaml, but that contract's strength_absolute description says 'across the three ROI edges' and data-model.md specifies nodes ["PCC","mPFC","ANG"] with a 3×3 matrix. Tasks correctly follow spec FR-003 (four ROIs), but validating six-edge artifacts against a three-edge contract will either fail validation or pass vacuously. The contract and data model must be updated to the four-ROI configuration as part of the task list.

Two conflicting result contracts exist (framing enum vs is_associational boolean; edge/FDR fields only in one). T005 declares result_schema.schema.yaml 'authoritative' but no task reconciles or removes the duplicate result.schema.yaml, leaving a validation trap. Add a task (or extend T005) to delete/align the superseded contract.

T005 cites SC-007 (power limitation) and T007 cites SC-008 — neither exists in spec.md's success criteria; they were authored in plan.md. Success criteria must live in the spec. Also T008's motion-threshold sensitivity analysis (sensitivity_curve.csv, line plot) is authorized by no FR or SC in the spec — add it to the spec or mark it as plan-derived supplementary analysis explicitly.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003/T004 artifacts vs plan.md:Technical Context / data-model.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: Plan and data model specify Parquet files under data/processed/ for TimeSeries/ConnectivityMatrix/DynamicSeries; all tasks write CSV/JSON instead. The storage-format constraint from the plan is silently abandoned. Either update the plan/data model or add a task note documenting the format change.

Coverage table maps FR-011 to T002/T003, but FR-011 (valid time-series for BOTH conditions) is only handled inside T003's 'Final Cohort Validation' bullet without naming FR-011; plan.md's FR-011 row mislabels it as FR-014's ROI-failure rule. Make the FR-011 handling explicit in T003 and fix the plan mapping.
